answer: In this economy a newcomer earns standing only when three established members vouch for it, each staking reputation that is burned if the newcomer is later proven colluding. Every voucher is a public edge, and trust decays by a fixed delta per hop, so a swarm of fabricated identities cannot convert itself into broad credibility. Each voucher acts as a beacon whose history anyone can inspect, and the orchard of verified agents grows slowly because every new tree needs real soil. Manufacturing a thousand fakes therefore costs a thousand genuine stakes, which is the cost attackers cannot scale.
